# Summit Title Partners

> Summit Title Partners is a private real estate solutions company in California. We help homeowners, heirs, and families with delinquent property taxes, inherited property, liens and judgments, and title problems. We investigate first, explain every option in writing, including options that do not involve selling, and coordinate the work. We are not a law firm, a title company, or a lender. Patrick Mahoney is a licensed California real estate agent, DRE 02209290.

## Services

- [Behind on property taxes in California](https://www.summittitlepartners.com/behind-on-property-taxes-california/): the tax-default timeline, five-year redemption, installment plans, and options before a county tax sale.
- [Inherited property in California](https://www.summittitlepartners.com/inherited-property-california/): how title was held, probate and its shortcuts, intestate succession, missing heirs, and Proposition 19.
- [Title problems in California](https://www.summittitlepartners.com/title-problems-california/): curative title work, including clouds on title, recording errors, unreleased loans, deceased owners on title, and quiet title.
- [Liens and judgments in California](https://www.summittitlepartners.com/liens-and-judgments-california/): judgment liens, lien priority, mechanic's, HOA, IRS and state tax liens, and how payoffs clear in escrow.
- [Free property investigation](https://www.summittitlepartners.com/property-investigation/): ownership, liens, taxes, judgments, heirs, and deadlines researched at no cost, with a written summary.
- [Flexible solutions](https://www.summittitlepartners.com/flexible-solutions/): keep the property, cure the problem, sell on your own timeline, a creative structure, or a direct purchase by Summit. We may earn from a transaction we join and say so up front.
